service_scope.value: New stair lifts sourced for the customer (straight stair lifts consolidated here) and professionally installed; maintenance and repairs of any stair lift, any brand, within the service area. Brands: Stannah, Bruno, Harmar (independent, no dealer wording). HMM is not a manufacturer. Manufacturer's warranty only.
service_scope.source: Brand Guide D (Services, Brands, Not offered, Warranty); Decision 005, 018; Paul 2026-10-07

service_process.value: Free in-home estimate, or a quote from a photo of the stairs (priced by stair count) → the lift is sourced new → installed usually in one day, about 3–4 hours, same-day in most cases → Jason Workens personally supervises every installation, to the manufacturer's installation instructions.
service_process.source: Brand Guide D (Free estimate, Installation time, Team size, Safety statement); Decisions 015, 016; Paul 2026-10-07
